name: finno-ugric-benchmark
description: A multilingual benchmark focused on Finno‑Ugric languages that evaluates NLP model performance across a set of language tasks (e.g., tagging, classification and parsing) for low‑resource languages in this family. It is intended to quantify cross‑lingual and language‑specific capabilities and provide standardized test data for research into these languages. Tasks and metrics are task‑specific and vary across included languages and annotations.
evaluation_method: task-specific (F1 for sequence labeling/NER; accuracy for classification; exact_match for parsing/QA where applicable)
general_score_metric: task-specific (F1 for NER/tagging; accuracy for classification; exact_match for parsing/QA)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task and language (commonly in the range 50–95% depending on task and language)
reputation: Curated by TartuNLP and hosted on Hugging Face; used by researchers working on Finno‑Ugric languages but adoption is moderate and mostly within specialized NLP groups.
